feature_name: Cloudflare Tunnel + Cloudflare Access remote web access
notes: User runs cloudflared and configures Access themselves; CMDeck stores the tunnel address and checks it. No server-side Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion verification (Access is enforced only at the edge; CMDeck auth still applies). Official mobile apps cannot pass Access (documented).

feature_name: Self-hosted orchestration MCP server reachable over tailnet
notes: Upstream /mcp + OAuth sign-in retained; fork adds opt-in bearer tokens with revocation closing open requests. Reached over Tailscale/own tunnel.

feature_name: No mandatory CMDeck-operated cloud service / paid infra
notes: Only CMDeck-hosted resources are GitHub repo files/releases (model-manifest.json, desktop update feed); both optional. No CMDeck server exists.

feature_name: Local model providers: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp
notes: Ported from M3 Code. Generic OpenAI-compatible servers; agents (Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Codex experimental) are linked to a server through CMDeck's gateway. Codex on local servers is marked Experimental.

feature_name: Windows/macOS/Linux execution environments
